name: Afro-Bench
purpose: Held-out benchmark of how Africans actually ask for things. Measures whether the router lands on the right tool AND whether its confidence predicts its own correctness. Never used to tune the router: the committed routing-eval fixtures were authored alongside the router and score 112/112, which measures memorisation, not understanding.
rules: Prompts must be phrased the way a user would type them, not the way a tool is titled.
acceptable[] lists every tool that would genuinely satisfy the user; the router is correct if it picks any of them.
A prompt whose honest answer is 'ask a clarifying question' has expectUncertain: true and no acceptable tool.
Do not add a prompt here after tuning the router on it. This set only stays honest while it stays held out.
